briefdescription.para: Whenever we update a request, we must update its header as well.

detaileddescription.para: We keep the original header instead of rebuilding it on commit in order to preserve the original replica id and lsn so that in case the request comes from a remote master, we will bump the master's component of the replica's vclock and hence won't try to apply the same row again on reconnect.

memberdef.argsstring: (struct request *request, struct space *space, struct tuple *old_tuple, struct tuple *new_tuple)
memberdef.name: request_create_from_tuple

briefdescription.para: Given old and new tuples, initialize the corresponding request to be written to WAL.

detaileddescription.para:
request
- request to fix
space
- space corresponding to request
old_tuple
- the old tuple
new_tuple
- the new tuple
If old_tuple and new_tuple are the same, the request is turned into NOP. If new_tuple is NULL, the request is turned into DELETE(old_tuple). If new_tuple is not NULL, the request is turned into REPLACE(new_tuple).
